invariants.rationale: The method expects pre-prepared records as input, and downstream operations will likely require a non-null list.
The instantTime is used for versioning/commit purposes, and an empty or null string would be invalid in typical Hudi workflows.
If there are records to process, instantTime must not be null for versioning/commit tracking.
List.size() is always non-negative; helps confirm the state of the input.
It is typical to expect each HoodieRecord in the input list to be non-null to prevent processing errors.
